name: Routal
description:
Routal is a delivery management platform for last-mile operations. This connector lets Claude work directly with your Routal workspace: import stops, build and optimize route plans, check vehicle setup, search and move stops between plans, and pull operational analytics.

Ask Claude to load today's deliveries from a spreadsheet, optimize the plan, and report how yesterday's routes performed — without opening another tab. Plans, stops, and optimizations created through the connector appear instantly in Routal for your dispatch team and drivers.

Built for operations managers who want their delivery operation to run the same way every day, whoever is on shift.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Routal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Routal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.routal.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Routal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Routal lists 25 MCP tools, including admin_get_optimization, admin_retrieve_blame, admin_retrieve_organization, admin_retrieve_project, admin_retrieve_user, admin_search_events, admin_search_organizations, admin_search_projects, admin_search_users, admin_start_as_user, admin_stop_as_user, and create_plan.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Routal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Routal in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Routal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Routal is developed by Routal. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
